extras.title: TAA
extras.text: Meets the requirements of the United States Trade Agreements Act (TAA). Footer marks: TAA, ETL (Intertek), FCC, DLC (see spec sheet on LED-LLC.com for DLC listing status).

extras.title: Part-number builder key
extras.text: Interpretation of the builder diagram (not catalog text): RP-T5C-G3 / RP-T8C-G3 (TAA Type C T5 / T8 kit) and RP-LBE-G3 (TAA linear barkit, external driver) are built as PREFIX-[WATTAGE]-[LENGTH]-[#LAMPS]-[8+COLOR]-[DIMMING]-[CONTROLS]-[EM#]-[TAA]. WATTAGE: 12W, 25W, 45W or 80W (each selectable within the settings shown in parentheses). LENGTH: 2, 3 or 4 FT. #LAMPS: 1L to 4L. 8+COLOR: color code 30 (3000K), 35 (3500K), 40 (4000K) or 50 (5000K) following the '8' prefix of the pattern (interpretation: 8 = 80+ CRI). DIMMING: 10V standard (0-10V dim); LVD (120-277V TRIAC), 1 STEP (single switch) or 2 STEP (2 switch) optional. CONTROLS and EM# (optional field installable emergency backup): see spec on LED-LLC.com for ordering information. TAA: TAA suffix.
